blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often asked several questions about the same image in a single prompt (co-asking), yet existing evaluations report conflicting accuracy gains and hallucinations at the prompt level without tracking how individual answers change. By pairing each question's single-question and co-asked answers across 22 open-weight VLMs (1B-35B), we find that erratic net shifts reflect two opposing effects: on Densely Captioned Images (DCI), every model repairs 15.4%-29.8% of its single-question errors under co-asking, while the share of correct answers turned wrong falls from 30.8% on weaker models to 4.7% on stronger ones. Across all 14 models supporting custom attention masks, we show through attention readouts and layer-window interventions that earlier same-image questions read visual information into their question tokens in the early-to-middle layers during prefill, helping later questions concentrate image attention onto their queried targets. This visual help accumulates across the scene even across non-overlapping regions, whereas blocking earlier questions from attending to the image lowers both target localization and accuracy in all 14 models. While cross-question help is established during shared question reading, part of the co-asking damage enters later during answer decoding when the decoder attends to other question stems. We therefore introduce Read Together, Answer Apart, a training-free decoding mask that keeps shared prefill intact and isolates each answer from other stems, improving co-asking accuracy on 12 of 14 models on DCI (up to +4.71 percentage points, closing 70% of the pooled gap to asking alone) and on 10, 8, and 5 of the 14 models on WebUI, FinTabNet, and GQA (up to +11.4, +5.3, and +1.1 points).
blocks.zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)常常在一个单一的即时(共同任务)中被问及关于同一图像的几个问题,然而,现有的评价却报告在即时的准确性增益和幻觉存在冲突,而没有跟踪单个答案的变化. 通过将每个题的单题和共同询问的答案对齐到22个开放量的VLM(1B-35B),我们发现无常的网格移动反映了两种相反的效果:在感知性悬浮图像(DCI)上,每个模型在共同询问下修复其单题错误的15.4%-29.8%,而正确答案的比例从弱模型的30.8%下降到强模型的4.7%. 在14个支持自定义关注面罩的模型中, 我们通过注意读取和层窗干预, 显示早期的同位素问题在预填时将视觉信息读入他们早期到中层的问题符号, 这种视觉帮助在整个场景中累积,甚至跨越非重叠区域,而阻碍早些时候的对图像的处理问题则降低了所有14种模型中的目标定位和准确性。 虽然交叉问题帮助是在共同的问题阅读中确立的,但当解码器处理其他问题时,部分共同请求的损害在回答解码时进入后期. 因此,我们引入了Read Conference, Assolute,一种免费的解码面具,保持共享预填完整,并将每个答案从其他答案中分离出来,提高了DCI的14个模型中的12个(最高+4.71个百分点,将集合缺口的70%关闭单独询问)和WebUI、FinTabNet和GQA的14个模型中的10、8和5个(最高+11.4、+5.3和+1.1分)的共同查询精度。

blocks.en:
Practical vision-language applications frequently ask many questions about a single image, such as extracting fields from a form or document [ 54 , 39 , 28 ] , inspecting user interfaces [ 43 ] , or querying objects and spatial relations across a busy scene [ 37 ] .
Rather than issuing a separate query per question, practitioners commonly pack the image and all numbered questions into one prompt before decoding the answers ( co-asking ).
Existing evaluations of co-asking in vision-language models (VLMs), however, report conflicting prompt-level conclusions: joint querying improves field extraction on documents [ 28 ] , whereas querying several objects at once on natural scenes increases hallucinations [ 6 ] .
Evaluated on Densely Captioned Images (DCI) [ 40 ] across 22 22 open-weight VLMs from seven model families ( 1 ​ B 1\text{B} to 35 ​ B 35\text{B} parameters) [ 4 , 3 , 11 , 25 , 55 , 41 , 13 , 8 , 47 , 31 ] , net accuracy shifts over asking alone span − 12.0 -12.0 to + 6.3 +6.3 percentage points ( Fig. 2 a) with no consistent trend across model scale.

Pairing each question’s single-question and co-asked answers ( Fig. 2 , Sec. 3 ) reveals why: across all 22 22 models on DCI, co-asking repairs 15.4 % 15.4\% – 29.8 % 29.8\% of single-question errors regardless of model size or net shift, while the share of single-question correct answers turned wrong drops from 30.8 % 30.8\% on weaker models to 4.7 % 4.7\% on stronger ones, so the balance between steady repair and falling damage sets each model’s net shift.
Before any answer is decoded, reading earlier questions about the same scene raises a later question’s attention on its target, relative to same-size random boxes, in all 14 14 models supporting custom attention masks ( Fig. 1 , Tab. 1 ).

Controlled context swaps and causal interventions on DCI trace how this help arises ( Sec. 4 ).
As more same-image questions precede a query in the 16 16 -question DCI prompt, repair rises from 11.1 % 11.1\% on the first question to 23.9 % 23.9\% on Questions 11–16, and it rises even on targets that no earlier question asked about ( Fig. 2 c,e); with length-matched text-only or other-image questions in front, repair instead peaks at Questions 2–5 and then declines.
Earlier questions contribute by reading the image themselves: blocking their attention to the image while keeping their text visible lowers both target localization and accuracy in all 14 14 mask-capable models ( Tab. 1 ).
Blocking one layer window at a time places this reading in the early-to-middle layers, followed 3 3 – 11 11 layers later by sharper target attention on the current question ( Fig. 4 ).

blocks.en:
In language models, batching several queries into one prompt reduces context overhead [ 7 , 24 ] , and stronger models often gain on composite text tasks [ 38 ] , though long prompts remain sensitive to query position and surrounding context [ 36 , 26 , 48 ] .
In VLMs, beyond sequential visual dialogue [ 10 ] , multi-question prompts yield conflicting aggregate results: joint querying improves field extraction on document forms [ 28 ] , whereas querying five boxed objects at once in ROPE increases hallucinations [ 6 ] .
Single-query methods instead decompose one question into sub-questions [ 20 , 52 ] or re-read the prompt [ 45 , 1 ] , while recent analyses note that extra text shifts decision margins [ 42 ] and flips individual predictions beneath flat aggregate accuracy [ 50 ] .
We pair each question between single-question and co-asked VLM prompts to separate cross-question repair from damage, and compare same-image questions against length-matched text-only and other-image questions to isolate scene-specific grounding ( Secs. 3 and 4 ).
blocks.zh:
在语言模型中,将几个查询分解成一个即时,会减少上下文的间接费用[7,24],更强的模型在综合文本任务上往往会获得[38],尽管长长的即时提示对查询位置和周围上下文仍然敏感[36,26,48].
在VLMs中,除了相继的视觉对话[10],多问题提示产生相互矛盾的总结果:联合查询会改善文档表格上的字段提取[28],而同时在ROPE中查询五个框形物体则会增加幻觉[6].
单调法将一个问题分解为子问题[20,52]或重新读取即时[45,1],而最近的分析则指出,额外的文本转移了决定边距[42],将单个预测翻转到平整的精度下[50].
我们把每个问题放在单个问题和共同要求的VLM之间,促使将交叉问题修复与损害区分开来,并将相同图像问题与长度匹配的文本问题和其他图像问题进行比较,以孤立特定场景的地面(第3和第4节)。

blocks.en:
When multiple queries share an image or text prefix, inference systems reuse key–value caches across branches [ 22 , 53 , 17 ] , share a live cache across concurrent workers [ 34 ] , or answer follow-up questions from compressed query tokens [ 18 ] .
Block-attention masks likewise isolate parallel context chunks encoded for a single query [ 33 , 29 , 2 ] .
To answer multiple questions over one shared context without cross-question interaction, Yu and Yao [ 46 ] decode each question in an isolated branch after one visual prefill, and Intra-Prompt Parallel Decoding (IPPD) [ 12 ] packs all questions into one prompt, masks them from one another in both prefill and decoding, and assigns virtual position IDs so that each answer follows its own question.
Both designs aim to reproduce independent single-question outputs; by contrast, we keep causal attention across questions during prefill so later questions benefit from earlier visual reading, and isolate other stems only during answer decoding ( Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
当多个查询共享一个图像或文本前缀时,推论系统重用密钥—跨分支的值缓存[22,53,17],在同时工作的员工之间共享一个活的缓存[34],或者回答来自压缩查询符的后继问题[18].
屏蔽眼罩同样隔离为单一查询编码的平行上下文块[33、29、2]。
要在一个共享的上下文中解答多个问题而不进行交叉问题交互,余和姚[46]在一个视觉预填后将每个问题解码在一个孤立的分支中,而内-Prompt并行解码(IPPD)[12]将所有问题打包成一个即时,在预填和解码中相互遮掩,并指定虚拟位置ID,使每个答案都遵循自己的问题.
这两种设计都旨在复制独立的单问题输出;相比之下,我们在预先填充时对问题保持因果的注意,因此后来的问题从早期的视觉阅读中受益,而只在解码(第5节)解码时孤立其他源头。

blocks.en:
Mechanistic studies on single image–question pairs examine how visual features transfer to internal representations and generated answers [ 5 , 30 , 16 , 32 ] , showing that visual information flows from image tokens into question tokens in the early-to-middle layers before propagating to the answer [ 18 , 51 , 35 ] .
On an isolated question, although attention already favors target regions above chance [ 49 ] , a large share is absorbed by background sink tokens [ 9 , 44 , 19 ] , motivating training-free attention calibration and cropping within a single query [ 14 , 27 , 49 , 23 ] .
Whereas Kaduri et al. [ 18 ] trace the single-question pathway from the image into that question’s own tokens, we show that earlier questions about the same scene pass visual context through their question tokens during prefill to guide later questions onto their targets ( Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh:
关于单一图像的机械研究–问题对子考察视觉特征如何转移到内部表达并生成答案[5,30,16,32],显示视觉信息从图像符流到早期到中层的质疑符流到传播到答案[18,51,35].
关于一个孤立的问题,尽管注意力已经有利于目标区域,而不是机会[49],但很大一部分被背景汇符号[9、44、19]吸收,促使在单一查询中进行无培训的注意校准和裁剪[14、27、49、23]。
Kaduri等人[18]将图像中的单一问题路径追踪到问题本身的符号中,我们显示,早先关于同一场景的问题在预先填充时通过问题符号传递视觉上下文,以引导以后的问题进入目标(第4节)。

blocks.en:
Opposing question-level flips underlie erratic prompt-level totals. Ordering all 22 22 VLMs by single-question accuracy on DCI ( Fig. 2 a; Supp. Tabs. S1 and S2 ) shows no consistent link between model capability and net co-asking shift ( Δ = Co − 1-Q \Delta=\text{Co}-\text{1-Q} , from − 12.0 -12.0 points on InternVL3-8B to + 6.3 +6.3 on InternVL3.5-30B-A3B): the weakest models barely move in aggregate (Ministral-3-3B + 0.2 +0.2 , MiniCPM-V-4.6 + 0.4 +0.4 ), whereas mid-ranked models such as Molmo2-O-7B and Qwen3.5-4B drop by 3.8 3.8 and 3.1 3.1 points.
Pairing predictions per question explains why ( Fig. 2 a).
Every one of the 22 22 models repairs 15.4 % 15.4\% – 29.8 % 29.8\% of its single-question errors under co-asking on DCI, with consistent one-pass co-asking repair across all 14 14 evaluated models on WebUI ( 12.9 % 12.9\% – 25.9 % 25.9\% ), FinTabNet ( 14.7 % 14.7\% – 46.8 % 46.8\% ), and GQA ( 7.8 % 7.8\% – 19.0 % 19.0\% ; Supp. Tab. S8 ).
Damage moves sharply in the opposite direction across capability: the share of single-question correct answers turned wrong falls from 23.8 % 23.8\% – 30.8 % 30.8\% on Ministral-3-3B and MiniCPM-V-4.6 to 4.7 % 4.7\% – 6.6 % 6.6\% on Gemma-4-31B, Qwen3.5-27B, and Qwen3-VL-32B, so the share of all answers that co-asking turns wrong largely decides whether a model’s net score rises or falls.

blocks.en:
Because image tokens precede all questions under causal masking, adding questions leaves the image token representations unchanged; any cross-question change therefore comes from how later question and answer tokens attend to the prompt.
Inspecting prefill question-to-image attention before any answer is decoded ( Fig. 3 ) reveals a consistent visual shift: on questions missed alone, middle-layer attention largely scatters over uninformative background patches [ 9 , 19 ] , whereas asking after earlier scene questions increases attention on each question’s own target both across questions on the same scene ( Fig. 3 a: 2.5 % → 18.4 % 2.5\%\to 18.4\% at Position 14 and 0.59 % → 19.8 % 0.59\%\to 19.8\% at Position 16) and across VLM families ( Fig. 3 b).
To quantify target localization across all 14 14 models while controlling for target-box area, we adapt the attention ratio of Zhang et al. [ 49 ] : at the final question token across Positions 2–16, we divide each question’s layer-averaged image attention on the ground-truth target box by its mean over same-size non-overlapping random boxes, without normalizing by a generic-description prompt ( 1.0 1.0 corresponds to chance, with raw single-question ratios already spanning 1.75 1.75 – 4.01 4.01 ; Supp. Tab. S3 ).
Dividing each condition’s ratio by asking alone ( = 1.000 =1.000 in Tab. 1 ) shows that co-asking raises target focus to × 1.01 \times 1.01 – × 1.55 \times 1.55 in all 14 14 models, even though earlier questions usually query other parts of the scene.

blocks.en: 4 Cross-Question Visual Grounding
blocks.zh: 4 跨问题视觉地面

blocks.en: 4.1 Preceding Context and Regional Overlap
blocks.zh: 4.1 事前背景和区域重叠

blocks.en:
Scene-specific context accumulates across positions. To test whether cross-question repair comes from scene-specific visual context rather than prompt length or numbered question syntax, we compare three preceding contexts at matched length and position while always viewing the target image ( Fig. 2 b,c, Tab. 1 ; examples in Supp. Fig. S1 b and per-model rates in Supp. Tab. S2 ): earlier questions about the same image , synthetic image-free text-only questions (arithmetic and word tasks), and questions written for another, unseen image (evaluated with a shared unanswerable-question clause; Supp. Sec. C ).
Pooled across all 22 22 models ( Fig. 2 c), Position 1 already shows small shifts ( 11.1 % 11.1\% , 10.0 % 10.0\% , and 8.3 % 8.3\% ) because under one-pass co-asking its answer A 1 A_{1} is decoded after trailing stems Q 2..16 Q_{2..16} ( Sec. 5 ); once earlier questions precede the query during prefill, repair after same-image questions climbs steadily to 20.3 % 20.3\% , 21.8 % 21.8\% , and 23.9 % 23.9\% across Positions 2–5, 6–10, and 11–16 ( 22.3 % 22.3\% across Positions 2–16).
By contrast, repair after text-only questions ( 15.7 % 15.7\% across Positions 2–16) or other-image questions ( 13.7 % 13.7\% ) peaks at Positions 2–5 and then declines.
Across Positions 2–16, same-image questions yield higher repair than text-only questions on all 22 22 models ( + 1.4 +1.4 to + 14.1 +14.1 points), beat other-image questions on 20 20 of 22 22 ( Fig. 2 b), and produce a higher target attention ratio than text-only questions in all 14 14 models ( Tab. 1 ).

blocks.en:
Cross-question help extends across non-overlapping regions. Splitting the 1,402 1{,}402 regional DCI questions at Positions 2–16 by whether the current target box overlaps any earlier question’s box ( IoU ≥ 0.1 \text{IoU}\geq 0.1 vs. IoU < 0.1 \text{IoU}<0.1 ; Fig. 2 e,f and Supp. Tab. S4 ), overlapping targets start higher at Positions 2–5 ( 25.0 % 25.0\% vs. 18.6 % 18.6\% pooled repair across all 22 22 models).
As more questions query other parts of the scene, however, repair on non-overlapping targets ( IoU < 0.1 \text{IoU}<0.1 ) climbs steadily from 18.6 % 18.6\% at Positions 2–5 to 21.2 % 21.2\% at Positions 6–10 and 22.5 % 22.5\% at Positions 11–16 ( Fig. 2 e), exceeding text-only questions on the same regional set across Positions 2–16 ( 20.9 % 20.9\% vs. 15.0 % 15.0\% , Fig. 2 f).
Asking about diverse parts of an image thus progressively builds scene-wide context that helps later questions locate new targets without querying the same object twice.

询问一个图像的不同部分,从而逐步建立全景背景,帮助以后的问题找到新的目标,而无需两次查询同一个对象。

blocks.en: 4.2 Blocking Earlier Image Attention
blocks.zh: 4.2 阻挡早期图像注意

blocks.en:
Because co-asking also exposes Q k Q_{k} to the text of earlier stems Q < k Q_{<k} , comparing co-asking with single-question prompting alone cannot separate visual reading from textual clues across stems.
To isolate visual reading during prefill, for each target question Q k Q_{k} ( k ≥ 2 k\geq 2 ) we keep all earlier stems Q < k Q_{<k} in the prompt and leave both Q < k → Q k Q_{<k}\to Q_{k} and direct V → Q k V\to Q_{k} open, blocking only earlier stems from attending to the image ( V ↛ Q < k V\nrightarrow Q_{<k} ; Fig. 4 a).
Unlike asking alone, Q k Q_{k} still reads the full text of Q < k Q_{<k} during prefill, so any lexical or format cues from earlier stems remain available; both the blocked run and its unblocked baseline also mask non-target stems during answer decoding with fixed prior answers A < k A_{<k} ( Secs. 3.1 and 5 ) so answer-time stem interference cannot confound the comparison.

Across the 20,797 20{,}797 Positions 2–16 pairs, blocking V → Q < k V\to Q_{<k} lowers accuracy in all 14 14 models ( − 1.77 -1.77 percentage points pooled on DCI, erasing 24.6 % 24.6\% of repaired answers pooled and 19.3 % 19.3\% – 36.9 % 36.9\% per model; Tab. 1 , Supp. Sec. C ).
Losses deepen as more earlier questions accumulate, growing from − 1.06 -1.06 points at Positions 2–5 to − 1.41 -1.41 at Positions 6–10 and − 2.56 -2.56 at Positions 11–16 (Supp. Sec. C ).
Target localization drops in parallel: in every model, blocking V → Q < k V\to Q_{<k} reduces the current question’s target attention ratio from × 1.01 \times 1.01 – × 1.55 \times 1.55 under co-asking to × 0.96 \times 0.96 – × 1.53 \times 1.53 ( Tab. 1 ).
Earlier questions thus contribute beyond textual clues by attending to the image during prefill, helping later questions locate their targets.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
Pairing individual questions across 22 22 open-weight VLMs shows that erratic prompt-level co-asking totals reflect two opposing effects: consistent cross-question repair ( 15.4 % 15.4\% – 29.8 % 29.8\% on DCI) in every model alongside capability-dependent answer damage.
Across all 14 14 models, attention readouts and layer-window interventions trace this repair to a two-step prefill pathway in the early-to-middle layers, where earlier questions read visual context into their tokens and help later questions focus on their targets.
blocks.zh:
在22个开放式VLM中标出单个问题,这表明不稳定的即时联合调查总数反映了两种相反的效果:每个模型中始终如一的交叉问题修复(15.4 % 15.4 — 29.8 % 29.8 % —29.8 % ) 以及依赖能力的答案损害。
在所有14个模型中,关注读取和层窗干预将这一修复追踪到早期到中层的两步预填路径,其中早先的问题将视觉上下文读到其符号中,帮助后来的问题聚焦于目标.

blocks.en: Exploiting this asymmetry, Read Together, Answer Apart needs no training: one shared causal prefill and an answer-time mask preserve cross-question repair and cut answer-time interference on 11 11 of 12 12 models hurt by co-asking.
blocks.zh: 探索这种不对称,"共同阅读,Answer Apart"不需要训练:一个共享的因果预填和一个答题时罩保存交叉问题修复,并切断12个模式中11个因共同询问而受伤的答题时干扰.

blocks.en:
Limitations and outlook. Our method requires custom attention masks with key–value caching and leaves prefill context load unchanged; on 20 20 -question tables, the two smallest Gemma-4 models trail co-asking ( Sec. 5.2 ), and understanding why is left for future work.
More broadly, causal attention keeps image tokens independent of later questions, so the cross-question gain comes from how questions read the image.
We hope this finding opens a new direction: using the image-reading behavior that arises in multi-question prompts to improve single-question VQA, for example by distilling it into single-question inference.
blocks.zh:
限制和前景。 我们的方法要求自定义的注意口罩带有密钥-价值缓存,预填上下文负载不变;在20个问题表上,两个最小的Gemma-4型号小径(Sec.5.2)并排(Sec.5.2),并理解为何留待未来工作。
更广泛地说,因果注意使图像符号独立于后来的问题,所以交叉问题收益来自于问题是如何读取图像的.
我们希望这一发现开启了一个新的方向:利用多问题提示中产生的图像读取行为来改进单问题VQA,例如通过将它提炼成单问题推论.
